name: CodeMafia
tagline: A multiplayer social-deduction game where players fix code together while a secret impostor sabotages it.

awards: Druide – Best Use of Language (Presentation) // Druide – Meilleure utilisation de la langue (présentation)

problem: The team wanted to combine coding practice with a game they love.
solution: Three to five players complete TODOs and pass tests in shared Python code running in the browser; one impostor secretly sabotages; players call meetings and vote.
demo_moment: Team-described: a round where the impostor breaks a test and gets voted out.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Druide – Best Use of Language (Presentation) // Druide – Meilleure utilisation de la langue (présentation)” among 260 submissions.
Borrows a game everyone in the room knows.
Won the prize for best use of language in the presentation.

lessons: A famous game's rules make a new idea instantly explainable.
